title: Hebrews 13:10-13 — Jesus suffered outside the camp
summary: Hebrews 13:10-13 in English with key words in colour: blood, Holy Place, Jesus, His, Him and He are highlighted. The passage says the bodies of the sin-offering animals were burned outside the camp, and Jesus likewise suffered outside the city gate to sanctify the people by His own blood. The header reads 13:10-14 but only verses 10-13 are shown.

text.text: 10 We have an altar from which those who serve at the tabernacle have no right to eat.
11 Although the high priest brings the blood of animals into the Holy Place as a sacrifice for sin, the bodies are burned outside the camp.
12 And so Jesus also suffered outside the city gate, to sanctify the people by His own blood.
13 Therefore let us go to Him outside the camp, bearing the disgrace He bore.
